name: @lisachandra/sandcastle
description: Three-phase agent issue runner (design → implement → review) with persistent worktrees, sequential issues, and integration composition
author: lisachandra <lisachandra@proton.me>

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsx --test src/agent-wrapper.test.ts src/agent.test.ts src/cli.test.ts src/config.test.ts src/evaluate.test.ts src/git.test.ts src/integrations.test.ts src/issue.test.ts src/main.test.ts src/retry.test.ts src/runtime.test.ts src/sequential.test.ts src/state.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage src/agent-wrapper.test.ts src/agent.test.ts src/cli.test.ts src/config.test.ts src/evaluate.test.ts src/git.test.ts src/integrations.test.ts src/issue.test.ts src/main.test.ts src/retry.test.ts src/runtime.test.ts src/sequential.test.ts src/state.test.ts
